userStories.title: Probe the runtimes on the brain and the hand
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a recorded runtime inventory of the brain and the hand so that the routing stories build on measured capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/hand-default-routing/evidence/probe.md` records, for `agro-supervisor` and for `agro-sbx-dev-001`: `systemctl is-active docker`, `docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}'` or its error, `ls -l /dev/kvm`, `msb --version`, group membership (`id -nG`), and `agro run --help` lines 1 to 4.
The probe records `agro hands list --json` on the brain and the set of `status` values that it shows.

The probe records `agro run --isolation microvm -- true` on the brain and on the hand, with each exit status. The probe records a refusal or a failure as the result and does not retry with weaker isolation.
The probe changes no service, VM, or file outside the evidence folder. The microVM smoke run creates no persistent guest.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: probe.md records docker state, kvm, msb 0.7.13, groups, agro run --help on brain (docker inactive) and hand (docker 29.1.3 active). 2 executed: agro hands list --json shows status running (the only status present). 3 executed: agro run --isolation microvm -- true exit 0 on brain and on hand; no persistent guest. 4 reasoned: only read-only commands and ephemeral microVM runs; evidence gitignored by design.

userStories.title: Start Docker on the brain
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the Docker engine enabled on `agro-supervisor` so that the local fallback `agro run` works when no hand is running.
acceptanceCriteria: `sudo systemctl enable --now docker` exits 0 on the brain, and `systemctl is-active docker` prints `active`.
`docker info --format '{{.ServerVersion}}'` exits 0 as user `exedev` without `sudo`.
From the harness root, `agro run -- true` exits 0, and `agro run -- sh -c 'id -u'` prints the uid of `exedev`.
After a reboot-equivalent check, `systemctl is-enabled docker` prints `enabled`.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: sudo systemctl enable --now docker exit 0; is-active active. 2 executed: docker info as exedev without sudo prints 29.1.3. 3 executed: agro run -- true exit 0 (pulled ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:0.37.0); agro run -- sh -c 'id -u' prints 1000 = exedev uid. 4 executed: systemctl is-enabled docker prints enabled. Evidence: evidence/docker-brain.md.

userStories.title: Route application runs to a running hand, else local Docker
userStories.description: As an agent, I want the sandbox skill to default application runs of committed work to a running hand, and otherwise to local Docker. Then heavy work leaves the brain, and the raw host never runs application work.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/sandbox/SKILL.md` § Select a route states the default in this order. First, an explicit location in the request wins. Second, a hand with status `running` in `agro hands list` takes application runs of committed work through `agro hands exec <hand> --project <owner>/<repo> -- agro run -- <command>`. Third, the route is `local/docker` with `agro run -- <command>`.
The skill states that a hand with status `paused`, `stopped`, or `creating` does not count as a running hand. The skill also states that the default never resumes or creates a hand.
The skill states that a failed `agro hands exec` stops and reports the error. The agent then offers `local/docker` and switches only after the operator agrees.
The skill states that a missing Docker engine on the local route stops and reports, with no fallback to the raw host.
The skill states that an inner loop on uncommitted edits stays on `local/docker`.
The skill states that one agent at a time uses a project on a hand. Parallel agents on the same project use separate hands, because `agro hands` has no worktree support on a hand.
`.agro/skills/sandbox/references/hands.md` § Choose when replaces "Keep short, light work on the brain." with the running-hand default. The section keeps the authority rule for billable create.

`.agro/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/sandbox-routing/cases.json` adds four cases. R12 to R14 use the request "Run the test suite for mifunedev/widget." R12 has a running hand and expects route `hands` with owners `agro-hands` and `agro-run`. R13 has only a paused hand and expects `local/docker` with owner `agro-run`. R14 has no hand and expects `local/docker` with owner `agro-run`. R15 has a running hand and the request "Run the test suite for mifunedev/widget on this host.", and expects `local/docker` with owner `agro-run`.
`helpers/sandbox-routing.ts` `caseIds` covers R1 to R15. `sandbox-routing.test.ts` expects R1 to R15 and uses R16 as the unknown case.
`sandbox-skill.test.ts` asserts the running-hand default, the paused rule, the explicit-location override, the one-agent-per-project rule, and the no-raw-host rule in `SKILL.md` and `hands.md`.

`decisions.json` holds 15 fresh decision-only records that the advisor collects against the final instruction files. Each record matches its oracle. The worker writes the file with provenance from `sourceProvenance()`.
`docs/lifecycle-commands.md` § Hands from a brain states the default in one bullet.
`CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` names the routing default under Changed, with a link to the task issue.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/sandbox/references/hands.md` exits 0, and `SKILL.md` gains no new finding.
`bash .agro/scripts/link-providers.sh --check` exits 0, `corepack pnpm typecheck` exits 0, and `corepack pnpm test:scripts` passes except the known baseline failures.
userStories.notes: 1-9, 11-12 reasoned/executed per worker report: SKILL.md default order, status rule, no resume/create, failed-exec stop/offer, no raw host, inner loop local, one agent per project per hand; hands.md Choose when replaced; cases R12-R15; caseIds R1-R15, unknown R16; skill test assertions; docs bullet; CHANGELOG Changed with #1633. 10 executed: 15 fresh decision-only records at afbb9bfc all match oracles; decisions.json a53677f9 with helper provenance. 13 executed: ste-check hands.md and SKILL.md no findings. 14 executed: link-providers --check exit 0; agro run -- pnpm typecheck exit 0; agro run -- vitest sandbox-routing + sandbox-skill 44/44 (advisor rerun); agro run -- pnpm test:scripts 3448 passed, 4 failed = standard-skills-link 5 s timeouts that also fail on origin/development under agro run (evidence/baseline.md). Code review repair round 1: b1d9ae66 orders the default (isolation selects runtime, explicit location, uncommitted edits local, hands list failure local, running hand that holds the project, push to hand-<hand> and HEAD match, else local/docker), adds R16 (separate kernel on hand) and R17 (uncommitted edits local), narrows test assertions, rewords docs as agent policy; 27d9869b names hand-<hand> as the push target after a replay showed R12 pushing to origin. 17 fresh decisions at 27d9869b match oracles (879635c1). agro run -- vitest sandbox-routing + sandbox-skill 44/44 (advisor). agro run -- pnpm test:scripts 3447 passed, 5 failed, all standard-skills-link 5 s timeouts in the file that fails on origin/development under agro run.

userStories.title: Record a live review through the routing tree
userStories.description: As the operator, I want one transcript of a real committed run on the running hand and on local Docker with the hand paused. Then the PR shows both branches of the default.
acceptanceCriteria: Before any write, a read-only `agro hands list --json` shows `agro-sbx-dev-001` with status `running`. If the check fails, the story sets `blocked`. The story then runs no other command.

`.agro/tasks/hand-default-routing/evidence/manual-review.md` records `agro hands exec agro-sbx-dev-001 --project ryaneggz/microsandbox-ubuntu-dind -- agro run -- sh -c 'for f in *.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done'` with exit 0.

The transcript records `agro hands pause agro-sbx-dev-001`. Next, the transcript records `agro hands list --json` with status `paused`. The transcript then records the same check through `agro run` in the brain project with exit 0. Last, the transcript records `agro hands resume agro-sbx-dev-001` with status `running`.
The transcript records `agro hands exec no-such-vm -- true` with exit 1 and `no exe.dev VM named no-such-vm`, as the failure path.
The transcript shows that the console tunnel `agro-console-tunnel` reconnects after the resume. `agro auth status` prints `login: dev`.
The run creates, forks, and destroys no VM. A pause of `agro-sbx-dev-001` needs operator approval of this plan. `external`
At the end, `ssh exe.dev ls --json` lists the same VMs, status, and tags as at the start.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: gate agro hands list --json running before any write. 2 executed: hands exec --project ryaneggz/microsandbox-ubuntu-dind -- agro run -- bash -n check exit 0. 3 executed: pause -> paused; local agro run check in brain project exit 0; resume -> running at +5 s, exec true exit 0 at +6 s. 4 executed: exec no-such-vm exit 1 'no exe.dev VM named no-such-vm'. 5 executed: agro auth status login: dev about 35 s after resume (fetch failed for about 30 s during reconnect). 6 external, reasoned: no create, fork, destroy, or tag; pause/resume approved by the plan. 7 executed: reduced ls --json before and after byte-identical.
